# Dialogs & Overlays shows the dialog, the toast and the popover working

Owned: a leaf of #21367 until its lock, Sun 22 Nov 18:00 CET. The group's renewal, after its defects (#21415, #21423, #21431).

## Context

#21140's target for Dialogs & Overlays is 3 cards; it shows 1. The rows on #21142 ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6980244557)) renew `dialog`, `component/toast` and `popover`, and leave the Tooltips example to a contributor (#21367). Measured on `dev` 5a3cb4de67:

- `examples/dialog` at 375 × 812: the option row does not wrap. "Animated" starts at x 392 and "Modal" at x 496, so two of the three checkboxes are off the screen.
- `examples/component/toast`: the printed call carries the example's own `appName` and `windowId` values and `import … from '../../../../node_modules/neo.mjs/src/component/Toast.mjs'`, a path that resolves only from that folder.
- `examples/popover`: opens in the window's corner until #21426 merges.

## The Problem

A card publishes only with a cover taken after its content is drawn (#21367). Dialog and toast have no capture recipe, and the popover has nothing worth capturing until its fix lands. A reader at phone width cannot reach two of the dialog's options, and a reader who copies the toast call gets values and a path that only work inside the example.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: #21367's terminal predicate, "every label drawn, focus where the page promises, nothing cut at 390 px, no card that opens on an error", and #21140's card count.

- Records: `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`. Capture recipes: `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json`, run by `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs`. The images ship in a companion `neomjs/pages` pull request, as #21328 did for the map.
- The catalog's count specs follow every card: `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/MainContainerController.spec.mjs` and `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs`.

## The Fix

- `examples/dialog/MainContainer.mjs`: the option row wraps, so every control stays on screen at 390 px.
- `examples/component/toast/MainContainer.mjs`: the printed call reads as code a component can run: `appName: this.appName, windowId: this.windowId` instead of their values, and no folder-relative import path.
- `example-captures.json`: recipes for the dialog (open), the toast (shown) and the popover (open at its button), each waiting until the content is drawn.
- `examples.json`: the three covers; the count specs follow; a `neomjs/pages` pull request carries the images.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: At 390 × 844, every control of `examples/dialog` is on screen.
- [ ] AC-2: The toast's printed call carries no literal window id and no import path that resolves only from the example's folder.
- [ ] AC-3: Dialogs & Overlays shows 3 cards (dialog, toast, popover), each cover taken after its content is drawn.
- [ ] AC-4: The catalog count specs follow the new cards.

## Out of Scope

- The Tooltips example: a contributor leaf (#21367).
- The dialog's title-bar hover: #21422.
